title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
description: Revised the tiling strategy from FlashAttention-1, reducing non-matmul FLOPs and improving thread block utilization. Achieves 50–73% of theoretical A100 MFU for attention — 2× faster than FlashAttention-1. Non-causal and multi-head attention coverage added.
